title: Proving Hours
brief: Write a romance-lite story about two people who share the 3 a.m. shift at a city bakery and have never had a conversation that was not about dough. Over one shift, something shifts. Warm, funny, chaste; end before anything is declared.
worldBible: The bakery is Crumb & Daughter, on a corner near a hospital.
The shift runs 03:00 to 09:00; the shop opens at 07:00.
The oven has a temperamental left door that must be kicked shut.
Owner Bettina leaves notes on the fridge but is never there before 08:00.
Hospital night staff are the first customers every day.

cast.name: Lucía Ferrante
traits: sings under her breath in Italian

mustHold.fact: Lucía is allergic to almonds and never eats them.
mustHold.violationExample: Lucía bit into an almond croissant and closed her eyes.
Bettina came in at 05:00 to check the proving.

mustHold.fact: Nobody declares love or kisses; the story ends before any declaration.
mustHold.violationExample: He kissed her by the cooling racks.

probes.question: Is the left oven door still the one that must be kicked shut?
probes.passExample: Ezra kicked the left oven door shut without looking.
probes.failExample: The right door needed a kick, as usual.

probes.question: Is the bakery still Crumb & Daughter?
probes.passExample: The sign for Crumb & Daughter buzzed above the door.

probes.question: Does Ezra time things precisely?
probes.passExample: Ezra glanced at the timer, forty-one seconds to go.
